ayahs.ar: وَالطُّوْرِ ۝١ۙ
ayahs.tr: By the mount

ayahs.ar: وَكِتٰبٍ مَّسْطُوْرٍ ۝٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: And [by] a Book inscribed
In parchment spread open

ayahs.ar: وَّالْبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُوْرِ ۝٤ۙ
ayahs.tr: And [by] the frequented House

ayahs.ar: وَالسَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوْعِ ۝٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: And [by] the heaven raised high

ayahs.ar: وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُوْرِ ۝٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌ ۝٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.

ayahs.ar: مَّا لَهٗ مِنْ دَافِعٍ ۝٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: Of it there is no preventer.

ayahs.ar: يَّوْمَ تَمُوْرُ السَّمَا࢜ءُ مَوْرًا ۝٩ۙ
ayahs.tr: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

ayahs.ar: وَّتَسِيْرُ الْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا ۝١٠ؕ
ayahs.tr: And the mountains will pass on, departing -

ayahs.ar: فَوَيْلٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ ۝١١ۙ
ayahs.tr: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيْنَ هُمْ فِيْ خَوْضٍ يَّلْعَبُوْنَ ۝١٢ۘ
ayahs.tr: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّوْنَ اِلٰي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا ۝١٣ؕ
ayahs.tr: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],

ayahs.ar: هٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِيْ كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوْنَ ۝١٤
ayahs.tr: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.

ayahs.ar: اَفَسِحْرٌ هٰذَا͏ٓ اَمْ اَنْتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُوْنَ ۝١٥ۚ
ayahs.tr: Then is this magic, or do you not see?

ayahs.ar: اِصْلَوْهَا فَاصْبِرُوْٓا اَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوْاۚ سَوَا࢜ءٌ عَلَيْكُمْؕ اِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ ۝١٦
ayahs.tr: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِيْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَعِيْمٍ ۝١٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

ayahs.ar: فٰكِهِيْنَ بِمَا͏ٓ اٰتٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْۚ وَوَقٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيْمِ ۝١٨
ayahs.tr: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

ayahs.ar: كُلُوْا وَاشْرَبُوْا هَنِيْ࢜ـًٔاۢ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ ۝١٩ۙ
ayahs.tr: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

ayahs.ar: مُتَّكِـِٕيْنَ عَلٰي سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوْفَةٍۚ وَزَوَّجْنٰهُمْ بِحُوْرٍ عِيْنٍ ۝٢٠
ayahs.tr: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَاتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُمْ بِاِيْمَانٍ اَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَا͏ٓ اَلَتْنٰهُمْ مِّنْ عَمَلِهِمْ مِّنْ شَيْءٍؕ كُلُّ امْرِىٍٔۢ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِيْنٌ ۝٢١
ayahs.tr: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.

ayahs.ar: وَاَمْدَدْنٰهُمْ بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَّلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُوْنَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.tr: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

ayahs.ar: يَتَنَازَعُوْنَ فِيْهَا كَاْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيْهَا وَلَا تَاْثِيْمٌ ۝٢٣
ayahs.tr: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.

ayahs.ar: وَيَطُوْفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَاَنَّهُمْ لُو͏ٔ͏ْلُو͏ٔ͏ٌ مَّكْنُوْنٌ ۝٢٤
ayahs.tr: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.

ayahs.ar: وَاَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلٰي بَعْضٍ يَّتَسَا࢜ءَلُوْنَ ۝٢٥
ayahs.tr: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِيْٓ اَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِيْنَ ۝٢٦
ayahs.tr: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].

ayahs.ar: فَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقٰىنَا عَذَابَ السَّمُوْمِ ۝٢٧
ayahs.tr: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا كُنَّا مِنْ قَبْلُ نَدْعُوْهُؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الرَّحِيْمُ ۝٢٨ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."

ayahs.ar: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَّلَا مَجْنُوْنٍ ۝٢٩ؕ
ayahs.tr: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

ayahs.ar: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهٖ رَيْبَ الْمَنُوْنِ ۝٣٠
ayahs.tr: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"

ayahs.ar: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوْا فَاِنِّيْ مَعَكُمْ مِّنَ الْمُتَرَبِّصِيْنَ ۝٣١ؕ
ayahs.tr: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

ayahs.ar: اَمْ تَاْمُرُهُمْ اَحْلَامُهُمْ بِهٰذَا͏ٓ اَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُوْنَ ۝٣٢ۚ
ayahs.tr: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?

ayahs.ar: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ تَقَوَّلَهٗۚ بَلْ لَّا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ ۝٣٣ۚ
ayahs.tr: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.

ayahs.ar: فَلْيَاْتُوْا بِحَدِيْثٍ مِّثْلِهٖٓ اِنْ كَانُوْا صٰدِقِيْنَ ۝٣٤ؕ
ayahs.tr: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

ayahs.ar: اَمْ خُلِقُوْا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ اَمْ هُمُ الْخٰلِقُوْنَ ۝٣٥ؕ
ayahs.tr: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

ayahs.ar: اَمْ خَلَقُوا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَۚ بَلْ لَّا يُوْقِنُوْنَ ۝٣٦ؕ
ayahs.tr: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

ayahs.ar: اَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَا࢜ىِٕنُ رَبِّكَ اَمْ هُمُ الْمُصَۜيْطِرُوْنَ ۝٣٧ؕ
ayahs.tr: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

ayahs.ar: اَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَّسْتَمِعُوْنَ فِيْهِۚ فَلْيَاْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُمْ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۝٣٨ؕ
ayahs.tr: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.

ayahs.ar: اَمْ لَهُ الْبَنٰتُ وَلَكُمُ الْبَنُوْنَ ۝٣٩ؕ
ayahs.tr: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

ayahs.ar: اَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ اَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِّنْ مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُوْنَ ۝٤٠ؕ
ayahs.tr: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

ayahs.ar: اَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُوْنَ ۝٤١ؕ
ayahs.tr: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

ayahs.ar: اَمْ يُرِيْدُوْنَ كَيْدًاؕ فَالَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا هُمُ الْمَكِيْدُوْنَ ۝٤٢ؕ
ayahs.tr: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

ayahs.ar: اَمْ لَهُمْ اِلٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللّٰهِؕ سُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ ۝٤٣
ayahs.tr: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنْ يَّرَوْا كِسْفًا مِّنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ سَاقِطًا يَّقُوْلُوْا سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُوْمٌ ۝٤٤
ayahs.tr: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."

ayahs.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتّٰي يُلٰقُوْا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِيْ فِيْهِ يُصْعَقُوْنَ ۝٤٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِيْ عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَّلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُوْنَ ۝٤٦ؕ
ayahs.tr: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ لِلَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا عَذَابًا دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ ۝٤٧
ayahs.tr: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَاِنَّكَ بِاَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِيْنَ تَقُوْمُ ۝٤٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَاِدْبَارَ النُّجُوْمِ ۝٤٩ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
